digest.component_or_area: LLM prompt caching for plan-review gate passes
propositions: Prompt cache writes occur on every plan-review gate call but are never read across different calls, paying premium write rates with zero benefit.
The marked cache breakpoint is positioned after pass-specific suffixes rather than at the shared plan-bearing prefix boundary, preventing within-run reads between verifier passes.
Cache prefixes embed the full plan text by design for within-run container reuse, so cross-ticket prefix identity is unsatisfiable without destroying warm-then-fan-out parallelism.
A second cache breakpoint at the end of shared_plan_prefix allows the finder write to be read by Pass-2 verifiers within one run and same-ticket re-reviews inside the TTL.
The write-every-call/read-never pattern is invisible to existing telemetry because warn_if_cache_ineffective only detects write==0 AND read==0, not sustained writes with zero reads.
